title: ES release notes disagree on the exact TAXII protocol versions
problem: The ES 8.2 introduction lists TAXII 2.0 and 2.1 for ES 8.2 and later. The current ES 8.8 compatibility paragraph repeats 2.0. The native feed task and TIM Cloud authentication highlight have distinct scopes.

deployments: Native threat intelligence and separate TIM Cloud connector
exclusions: No current TAXII 2.1 support or removal is inferred. TIM Cloud authentication and STIX document parsing do not establish the native TAXII protocol version.

impact.customerScenario: Planning a native threat-intelligence feed or TIM Cloud connector change involving a TAXII 2.1 endpoint.
impact.consequence: The conflicting wording can produce an unsupported protocol assumption during integration planning.

confidence.rationale: Compared exact official 8.2 introduction, 8.8 compatibility paragraph, native feed scope and TIM Cloud release highlight. Confidence applies to the documentation discrepancy.

lifecycle.reason: The exact current native and TIM Cloud protocol list needs authoritative clarification.

scopeComparison: The 8.2 introduction speaks to ES 8.2 and later and links to the native feed task. The 8.8 compatibility paragraph repeats 2.0; the separate 8.8 TIM Cloud feature concerns authentication.
